description:
Udaya 2.0 is a 12-hour innovation-driven hackathon organised by the Department of Computer Science & Design at Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, Bengaluru.
Bringing together aspiring developers, designers, problem-solvers and innovators, Udaya 2.0 provides a platform to transform ideas into meaningful solutions through creativity, collaboration and technology.
Participants will explore three exciting domains i.e. AI/ML & Generative AI, Sustainability & Social Impact, and Open Innovation, challenging themselves to think beyond conventional boundaries and build solutions to real-world problems.

hackathon_faqs.answer: UDAYA 2.0 will take place on December 4, 2026, at Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, Bengaluru, in Building No. 22, 4th Floor.
hackathon_faqs.question: When and where is UDAYA 2.0 happening?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Students only from DSCE from different departments are welcome to participate. UDAYA 2.0 is an inter-department DSCE only hackathon encouraging students from diverse backgrounds to collaborate.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in UDAYA 2.0?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Participants can build solutions under three domains: 
1)AI/ML & Generative AI
2)Sustainability & Social Impact
3)Open Innovation.
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the domains for the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Bring your laptop, charger, student ID, and any other essentials required for developing and presenting your project. Make sure your development environment is ready beforehand.
hackathon_faqs.question: What should I bring to the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Food and refreshments will be arranged for participants during the event. Further details regarding meal timings will be shared by the organizing team.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will food and refreshments be provided?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes! Participants are encouraged to form their teams beforehand and come prepared with ideas. However, the actual solution development should follow the hackathon guidelines.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I form a team before the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: UDAYA 2.0 features a total prize pool of ₹27,000, rewarding outstanding innovation, creativity, technical execution, and real-world impact.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the prize pool for UDAYA 2.0?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, problem-solving, technical implementation, feasibility, impact, and the quality of the final presentation.
hackathon_faqs.question: How will projects be evaluated?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes, participants may use AI tools, APIs, frameworks, and open-source libraries to enhance their solutions. However, teams should understand their implementation and be able to explain their work.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we use AI tools, APIs, and open-source libraries?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Mentorship and guidance may be provided during the event to help participants overcome technical challenges, refine their ideas, and improve their solutions.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will mentors be available during the hackathon?
